overview: YasinForge is an immersive 3D WebGL agency website for web development studio YasinForge, founded by Bilal Yasin. Features scroll-driven 3D animations, a portfolio showcase with individual project pages, client testimonials, a blog with case studies and standalone articles, and an admin dashboard for full content management.
features: Immersive 3D WebGL objects that react to scrolling
Portfolio showcase with individual project pages
Client testimonials on home page, project pages, and dedicated page
Blog with case studies tied to projects and standalone articles
Admin dashboard with full CRUD, feature toggles, and tag management
Contact form with WhatsApp and email links
